aiAssistantsPageLead: Ask ChatGPT or Claude what you can book at Deskohub Workspace, when it's free and what it costs. You finish the booking on our website.

aiAssistantsChatGptStepFind: In ChatGPT, open Apps and search for "Deskohub Workspace".
aiAssistantsChatGptStepAdd: Open the app and follow the steps to add it.
aiAssistantsChatGptStepAsk: In a chat, ask something like "Is there a free desk at Deskohub Workspace next Tuesday?"
aiAssistantsChatGptSignIn: You don't need an account to look up spaces and prices. To see your reservations, sign in to your Deskohub Workspace account when ChatGPT asks.
aiAssistantsClaudeStepFind: In Claude, open Connectors and search for "Deskohub Workspace".
aiAssistantsClaudeStepAdd: Open the connector and follow the steps to add it.
aiAssistantsClaudeStepAsk: Ask something like "What does the meeting room at Deskohub Workspace cost for two hours on Friday?"
aiAssistantsClaudeSignIn: You don't need an account to look up spaces and prices. To start a reservation or see yours, sign in to your Deskohub Workspace account when Claude asks.
aiAssistantsCustomConnectorHeading: Add it as a custom connector
aiAssistantsCustomConnectorIntro: In other assistants and apps that support MCP, add Deskohub Workspace as a custom connector with this URL:
aiAssistantsCustomConnectorSignIn: When you connect, you sign in to your Deskohub Workspace account and approve access. The assistant can then list your reservations, check their status and hold the dates you pick. It gives you a payment link. Pay on our website before the link expires.
aiAssistantsPaymentOnSite: No assistant can pay for you. You check the details and pay on our website, from the link the assistant gives you. After you pay, the website shows whether your reservation is confirmed.
aiAssistantsPaymentSiteIsCurrent: If the website shows a different price or free time than the chat, go by the website.
aiAssistantsDataBody: You can use the app in ChatGPT and Claude without a Deskohub Workspace account. An assistant sees your reservations only after you sign in and approve access. OpenAI and Anthropic handle your chat under their own terms. Read more in our <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
aiAssistantsDisconnectBody: Remove the app or connector in the ChatGPT or Claude settings. To revoke an assistant's access to your account, go to <assistants>Connected assistants</assistants> in your account.
aiAssistantsTroubleshootingNotUsed: If the assistant doesn't use the app, mention Deskohub Workspace in your message or pick the app in the chat.
aiAssistantsTroubleshootingSignIn: If sign-in fails, remove the app or connector, add it again and sign in.

cookieConsentPreferencesUsageDescription: You can decide which optional cookie categories are allowed. Necessary cookies stay enabled because the site depends on them.
cookieConsentPreferencesNecessaryDescrip: These cookies support core website operation, language selection, storing your consent choice, keeping you signed in to your customer account, and remembering the referral code from a shared link so its discount can be applied.
cookieConsentPreferencesAnalyticsDescrip: These cookies help us measure site usage, reservation form reliability, and campaign effectiveness. Reservation analytics do not include form values or personal details.
cookieConsentPreferencesMarketingDescrip: These cookies would support advertising or remarketing tools if they are enabled in the future.
cookieConsentPreferencesPersonalizationD: These cookies remember optional display or interaction preferences when such features are available.
cookieSettingsDescription: Use this page to review or update which optional cookie categories you allow on the Deskohub Workspace site.
cookieSettingsNecessaryDescription: Required for basic functionality, language selection, security, and storing consent choices.
cookieSettingsAnalyticsDescription: Help us evaluate site usage, reservation form reliability, and campaign effectiveness without sending reservation form values or personal details.
cookieSettingsMarketingDescription: Would support advertising or campaign measurement tools if they are used later.
cookieSettingsPreferencesDescription: Remember optional presentation or interaction choices when those features exist.
